## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits with descriptive bodies, fixups are squashed, and every
      commit builds and passes tests.
- [ ] `docs/wiki/` updated for any change to behavior, configuration, API or operations. Pages
      touched:
- [ ] Database migrations are backward-compatible with the previous API release.
- [ ] Prompt changes (`apps/api/src/analysis/prompts.ts`) reviewed by their code owner.
- [ ] Auth, permission or tenant-scoping changes reviewed by their code owner.
- [ ] No secrets, keys or customer data.
